primary: All targets present, production citation/heading guard passes, exact ordered marker inventory if used, and fixed-panel manual source scope/fidelity pass. Never equate key coverage or marker presence with semantic accuracy.
selection: After B1/P1/M1, select a P or M candidate only if guard and manual panel pass and total latency <=1.25*B1. Prefer lower latency; then lower output tokens. Lock one selection and repeat it twice without changes. If neither qualifies, stop without confirmations.
stopping: Stop all on HTTP/transport/incomplete failures. A failed candidate is not tuned or repeated. Stop confirmations at first guard/manual failure. No model/endpoint/key/billing changes or automatic repairs.
firstItemMs: unmeasured by shared keyed collector; compare total latency and first text only
